dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I must admit that I'm doubtful myself...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: You... Alright, it is true. An evil-doer turning about suddenly and claiming to wish to do good? You'd sooner trust a venomous snake that greets a person warmly with fangs dripping...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Fortunately, Mécantre and Babisse have agreed to let me stay here for a time... I've also agreed to provide financial support to their mega cannon.

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Perhaps I must do something tangible and visible to prove my intent...

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Their giant cannon project really does have a lot of appeal, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: Even if it can't be built, the project name itself will attract many investors.

dialogues.speaker: Grundeland
dialogues.text: And then, we just need to work a little magic and...
